tha-ap229:1.1: Uyyānabhūmiṁ → G. Uyyāna bhūmi; S2 uyyanaṁ bhūmiṁ. (pts note) | niyyanto → G. niyanto; S1 nisinno. (pts note)
tha-ap229:2.1: samāruyha hatthikkhandhagato → samoruyha hatthikkhanvadhagato (bj) | tato → gato (sya-all) | samāruyha → samārūḷho (pts) | samoruyha → samāruyha (bj: machasaṁ) | samārūḷho → S1 samāruyha. (pts note)
tha-ap229:3.2: pupphamabhiropayiṁ → pupphamabhipūjayiṁ (bj, pts) | pupphamabhipūjayiṁ → pupphamabhiropayiṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | abhipūjayiṁ → G. S1 -ropayiṁ. (pts note)
tha-ap229:3.4: pupphapūjāyidaṁ → buddhapūjāyidaṁ (bj, sya-all, pts) | buddhapūjāyidaṁ → pupphapūjāyidaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap229:4.3: mahāpatāpanāmena cakkavattī → mahāpatāpo nāmena cakkavatti (sya-all) | mahāpatāpanāmena → mahāpatāpo nāmena (pts) | Mahāpatāpo → S1 Mahapatāpo. (pts note)
